description_policy: Descriptions are paraphrased capture summaries, not verbatim source text. description_raw is null.
tag_policy: Page-level tags remain separate. Only explicit per-skill list entries and inline section tag prefixes are attached. Null tags mean no section-level mapping was recorded in this batch.

sections.name: Vicious Bite
sections.description_summary: Strikes one enemy 10 times; each hit deals damage plus bonus based on the target's lost HP. Final strike knocks down. While casting, Harak is unaffected and prevents target HP recovery for 6 s, causing periodic HP loss.

sections.name: Tidal Assault
sections.description_summary: Dives to the weakest enemy, damages and knocks them back. Harak is invincible underwater; assists/defeats reset cooldown.

sections.name: Flesh Feast
sections.description_summary: Opening feast mode grants Crit and Haste for 12 s, refreshed by assists/defeats. When feast ends, Harak loses control and devours the weakest non-summoned unit (ally or enemy) if target HP is below the stated ATK threshold.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Life Drain, stacking on assists/defeats.

sections.name: Ravenous Digestion
sections.description_summary: Assists/defeats grant a portion of defeated unit ATK and max HP, with caps; higher rank heals based on defeated unit max HP.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: After assisting/defeating two units, Harak recovers 700 Energy from Vicious Bite. LV 2 improves opening feast with attack speed, Energy, ATK/HP, damage reduction and lost-HP-based bonus damage.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Harak's own-skill displacement grants ATK; higher ranks also grant a shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a separate opening defensive/offensive effect and refine stats.

sections.name: Vein Pulse
sections.description_summary: Passive: deploys two laser turrets at battle start. Turrets attack enemies; if placed within 2 tiles, they link and focus the nearest enemy, dealing repeated damage and reducing shield value. Active: Zanie increases her own and turrets' ATK SPD and ATK for 10 s; turret attacks gain current-HP-based bonus damage.

sections.name: Iron Defense
sections.description_summary: Builds a gun turret in front of Zanie. After two normal attacks, its next attack fires six rounds, each damaging, stunning and knocking back the target.

sections.name: Field Repairs
sections.description_summary: When the gun turret is destroyed, Zanie repairs it once per battle; active effect repairs the weakest laser turret, restoring HP and granting a shield.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Penetration.

sections.name: Precision Overload
sections.description_summary: Periodically upgrades one turret, increasing max HP, ATK and range; frontmost laser turret has priority.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Laser turret hits burn the target, reducing ATK and dealing damage over time; linked turrets also reduce Phys DEF.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK and Phys/Magic DEF for the caster and created units; higher ranks add Haste after 5 s.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate normal-attack stacking effects and refine stats.

source_notes: The source page excerpt displays unusual cooldown formatting for Precision Overload; preserve the raw source value separately if parsing its numeric cooldown.

sections.name: Aloft Edge
sections.description_summary: Summons six flying blades; for 8 s, normal attacks launch blades at enemies.

sections.name: Gravity Collapse
sections.description_summary: Blades leave Blademarks; after four normal attacks, the next attack hits the enemy with the most Blademarks, knocks them down and detonates marks. Aloft Edge modifies range and adds extra blades.

sections.name: Tempered Field
sections.description_summary: Opening field increases Ranged DEF; blades passing through it deal extra max-HP-based true damage. Field disappears when Silven moves and returns after he stands still for 3 s.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD.

sections.name: Oath of Fealty
sections.description_summary: Receiving a temporary stat buff from an ally restores Energy, permanently increases Penetration, and increases ATK SPD for Silven and that ally; once per ally.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Deals 25% more damage to enemies whose current HP ratio is above 50%.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD and normal-attack lifesteal; higher ranks add Penetration while above 50% HP.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate normal-attack stacking effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Crimson Venom
sections.description_summary: Applies 10 s poison to an enemy, dealing damage per second plus a component based on the enemy's lost HP.

sections.name: Razor Talons
sections.description_summary: Performs two claw strikes followed by 5 s of damage over time.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK.

sections.name: Curse Feast
sections.description_summary: Each Withering Curse lash restores Energy and permanently increases damage dealt, up to a cap. Defeating an enemy with Crimson Venom restores Energy based on remaining venom duration.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: At battle start targets the ally one tile in front, drains some of their current HP, and grants Shadewing ATK, Life Drain and a shield lasting the battle.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK per enemy affected by caster continuous-damage effects. Higher ranks make those effects reduce Phys/Magic DEF.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate opening/assist/defeat stats and refine effects.

sections.name: Starlit Slumber
sections.description_summary: Summons Sonny and falls asleep; Sonny inherits a portion of Aurora's stats and inspires allied summons with Haste and improved movement. The frontmost enemy is marked as Nightmare, losing Haste but gaining a small ATK increase; allied summons focus it. Aurora is invincible while asleep and wakes if Sonny is defeated.

sections.name: Dreamspark Bunny
sections.description_summary: Summons a temporary bunny with inherited stats that explodes on expiration, damaging adjacent enemies.

sections.name: Plushification
sections.description_summary: Enemies remaining near sleeping Aurora are transformed into plushies, preventing movement and attacks; repeated transformations become faster over time. Does not affect unaffected enemies.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: ATK increases based on the number of allied summons created by different allies.

sections.name: Dream Veil
sections.description_summary: While asleep, increases damage of allied summons and gives melee/ranged summons different roles and effects; Sonny receives both.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: If Aurora has more than 500 Energy while asleep, Plushification range expands to 3 tiles.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK and Phys/Magic DEF for the caster and created units; higher ranks add Haste after 5 s.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate Ultimate-triggered damage/Energy effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Circle of Vigil
sections.description_summary: Passive alternates Zorya between dormant and awake states. Dormant state is invincible and restores Energy/HP; when Energy fills, she awakens, jumps to the densest enemy area and stuns nearby enemies. While awake, she consumes Energy continuously; at zero she becomes dormant. Energy from other sources cannot modify her Energy, but would-be Energy gains permanently increase ATK.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases damage dealt, with extra damage when at least two enemies are nearby.

sections.name: Intimidating Field
sections.description_summary: While awake, creates a field reducing enemy movement speed and Haste while increasing Zorya's Haste. Allied Ultimates permanently increase the field's Haste bonus up to a cap.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: When a fatal blow would land, channels all Energy to survive and immediately enters dormant state, once per battle.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Deals magic damage to adjacent enemies and heals based on actual damage; higher ranks add opening unaffected duration.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a separate timed defensive/offensive effect and refine stats.

sections.name: Savage Slash
sections.description_summary: Slams an enemy, destroys obstacles within 2 tiles and damages/knocks airborne nearby enemies.

sections.name: Rallying Roar
sections.description_summary: Opening illusions charge forward in a wedge, damage and destroy obstacles; allies passed through gain max HP, Life Drain, Haste and movement speed. Active cast buffs nearby allies with Life Drain and Haste.

sections.name: Shock Stomp
sections.description_summary: Damages and stuns enemies within 1 tile.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases max HP, with extra max HP while Rallying Roar buffs are active.

sections.name: Hunter's Fury
sections.description_summary: While above 50% initial max HP, normal attacks gain max-HP-based bonus damage; higher rank enhances the next normal attack of inspired allies.

capture_status_notes: The capture excerpt ends during Exclusive Equipment level details; Enhance Force, Season Charm and Rivalry Mode require recapture.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: After her score is activated, Sylphira performs Tremolo to enhance normal attacks. Enhanced attacks gain Life Drain and deal extra true damage based on target max HP, with an ATK cap.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Damage dealt and damage reduction increase; both effects are stronger while on the enemy side of the battlefield. Higher ranks add a permanent shield on first entry to the enemy side.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate opening/assist/defeat stats and refine effects.

sections.name: Whirlwind Wrath
sections.description_summary: Spins Mountain's Roar, dealing damage each second to adjacent enemies for 4 s; Brutus is unaffected while spinning. LV 3 grants damage immunity while spinning.

sections.name: Ferocious Roar
sections.description_summary: Taunts enemies within 2 tiles and reduces their Phys DEF for 9 s.

sections.name: Indomitable
sections.description_summary: Immune to the first fatal blow.

capture_status_notes: The capture excerpt stops during Indomitable; remaining skills, Hero Focus, equipment, Enhance Force, Season Charm and Rivalry Mode require recapture.

sections.name: Winter Anthem
sections.description_summary: Opening passive reduces Haste and range for all units except Alna. Active blizzard removes enemy Haste buffs and deals repeated damage; while active, Alna and Winter Warrior recover part of damage taken over time.

sections.name: Shared Resolve
sections.description_summary: Selects an ally in the same row as Winter Warrior, grants immunity to Winter Anthem's Haste reduction and permanently increases their max HP. Active thrust damages enemies and restores HP to Alna and Winter Warrior.

sections.name: Wild Whirl
sections.description_summary: Attacks nearby enemies and reduces their Haste.

capture_status_notes: The capture excerpt ends during Wild Whirl scaling; Hero Focus, Exclusive Equipment, Enhance Force, Season Charm and Rivalry Mode require recapture.
